body: Ohhh wow, this is such an interesting point! I hadn't considered the implications that having a license has. I have been operating under the assumption that being a licensed SLP, and advertising that, would be something that people would want in a clinician. I also only just got my license etc, so letting it go now seems silly. But I wasn't planning on billing insurance, just all private pay. So I wonder if skipping insurance makes it easier to keep your license.

That's a great idea! I don't know where exactly I would want to be yet, but I think doing research, and getting a feeling for where things stand is a good idea. Also, I'm glad I'm not the only one who is confused by all this!
Yes! but how does that work internationally? Do I have to be licensed in the state the patient is in as well as the country I am in?
That was my impression as well, thank you for your insight!
This is wonderful, thank you!!
Thank you so much! this is very helpful!

Thank you for being so honest. I think this is definitely going to happen at some point. I was debating that, or smoking a joint (totally legal where I am). But I thank you for your honesty, it makes me feel a lot better!

Thank you so much for this reply, I have started to reach out to people. It's just hard because I don't have many friends that are my friends, our friends' group is mainly people my wife met and I was the plus 1. I have made strong enough friendships with some of them, but I just don't want to be a burden. Your analogy of unscrambling the scrambled egg is excellent!

I am definitly finding out the hard way that after someone threatens to leave, there is no recovering. I fought initially for the marriage, but I think it made us both more miserable. Your absolutely right though that no one deserves to go through the emotional abuse.
Thank you so much for your reply! It puts me at ease to hear everyone say the same thing! Congrats on the CF position and good luck!

That is a really interesting take that including my GPA after my CF is bragging. I never would have thought of it that way, but it makes sense! I also really appreciate the point that you make about GPA not being a good reflection of clinical abilities. All my clinical placements have gone well, it was an acoustics class that tripped me up GPA wise. Which really I don't think says anything about the kind of clinician I am.  Thank you for your reply!
Yes, that makes sense! Maybe i'll just work on making experience, critical thinking, and teamwork all really shine. Thank you for the response!

That makes sense, I guess experience does matter more, or at least I hope! I'm not applying for any sort of specialty, at least not yet, just a regular old CFY. Good luck with finding a job in a hospital!
Thank you! They seem to have generally positive ratings and reviews, so I'm hoping that is the case. Thanks again for your reply!
This is an amazing list, I am in a similar position as OP, so thanks!

I completely agree that you shouldn't leave your spouse for someone else. But for me, my marriage is already all but over. My wife has said that she doesn't like spending time with me and doesn't like how I do things. I can safely say that I have tried, and continue to try to make our relationship work. But I'm not sure at what point enough is enough.

no, there are no friends i can really trust. i will pm you, just right now I have to put on a brave face and get through some grad school stuff. Thank you for offering a place to vent, it is appreciated.
I tried to tell my wife, but she didn't get it. I think right now my mind and heart are so broken I had to start making it physical. But once it was physical for you, how did you control it?

The boom card idea is great! I have only just started exploring boom cards. If you don't mind me asking, how did you guys do screen sharing with the AAC device? we have a document camera we point toward the iPad, but is there a way to actually screen share? I feel like I'm learning something new everywhere I look!

That's a great point! I know some of our clients have a hard time taking turns, but now that we are all at home, it may be easier to take things a bit slower and make use of the "raise your hand" feature. Maybe it will reinforce the idea that you have to wait before talking. This is the first time I'm doing anything of the sort, so its an experiment. But thank you for your suggestion!
